script_text: The ancient ones warned that when Neptune shifts houses, spirit animals wake from their slumber. Spirit Animals, ruled by Neptune in your 1st House, this transit is not abstract — it is visceral. On May 18, 2026, Neptune in Aries forms a sextile to your 7th House Moon, stirring a love connection that has been dormant since Saturn left your 4th. You will meet someone whose energy mirrors your deepest fears and desires, likely through an unconventional social setting. In your 10th House, Pluto in late Aquarius squares your natal Sun, forcing a career reinvention — a lucrative opportunity surfaces in healing, art, or animal advocacy, but demands you release old financial patterns rooted in control. This is Chiron retrograde territory; your shadow lesson is learning that power without compassion breeds loneliness. Ground yourself in your element — water — and trust the current. Comment your rising sign for a deeper reading.
